Atria Investments Has Trimmed Position in Lyondellbasell Industries N (LYB) as Market Value Declined; Esperion Therapeutics (ESPR) Shareholder Pentwater Capital Management LP Has Decreased Its Stake
May 10, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Matthew Halbower decreased its stake in Esperion Therapeutics Inc (ESPR) by 14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pentwater Capital Management Lp sold 313,969 shares as the company’s stock rose 22.41% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Matthew Halbower held 1.93 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $127.02 million, down from 2.24 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pentwater Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Esperion Therapeutics Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.09 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.73% or $1.14 during the last trading session, reaching $40.6. About 844,283 shares traded. Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:ESPR) has risen 89.86% since May 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 78.31% the S&P500.
